sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165255 and /rates (Scan & Pay listing; the catalog is one placeholder site)

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165255 ('No dump station, electricity or water hook-ups available') + FS page ('No dump station or hook-up is available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water, trash, toilets and the host (based at Meridian Campground) only in the full-service season, Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend; pack it in, pack it out.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/deer-creek-campground (Water 'Potable water is available at this site.'; Restrooms 'Available during peak season only'; 'The area also has an extended season when services such as water, trash or a host may not be available'; 'No dump station') + recreation.gov notice ('Pack It In - Pack It Out'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Full service Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend; weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/deer-creek-campground ('The campground is open year-round, though full service is only available Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend.'; Seasons of Use 'Year-round'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Claim a site in person and occupy it the same night; pay by cash, check or money order, or Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app. One RV (or two vehicles) per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/deer-creek-campground ('The sites at this campground are not reservable.'; 'Scan and Pay is available. First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the same night.'; 'two tents and two vehicles or one recreation vehicle (RV) is allowed per site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165255 ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a site (two vehicles or one RV included); third vehicle $11.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/deer-creek-campground ('$28 fee per site for overnight camping ... There is an $11 fee for a third vehicle.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165255/rates (2026 WalkInScanPay1 28), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/deer-creek-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites.'), read 2026-10-28

note: South Platte RD (Pike NF), concessionaire-run: a heavily wooded campground at ~9,170 ft where Deer Creek and Camp Creek meet, 2 mi up the dirt road beyond the CR 43A split (from US 285 at Crow Hill, toward Harris Park) near Bailey. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 13 FCFS sites (count left as stored), no hookups, $28 (2026, third vehicle $11), not reservable.
